releaseNotes: Multi-Attachment Support: Upload and view multiple documents (Images, PDF, Excel sheets) together in one task without removing previous files
Discussion Input Fix: Comment input bar and typed text are fully visible above the keyboard with auto-scroll and quick jump to discussion
In-App Staff Creation: Super Admin, GM, and Dept Managers can create user/staff accounts directly within the mobile app
Instant Live Sync: Automated background auto-fetch every 6–8s and foreground app resume sync across app and web portal
